wonders.line: You say you've seen seven wonders
stanza: You say you've seen seven wonders

wonders.line: We are filled with riches and wonders
stanza: We are filled with riches and wonders
Our love keeps the things it finds
And we dance like drunken sailors
Lost at sea, out of our minds
You find shelter somewhere in me
I find great comfort in you

wonders.line: If I live to see the seven wonders
stanza: If I live to see the seven wonders
I'll make a path to the rainbow's end
I'll never live to match the beauty again

wonders.line: In the middle of the shore, she wonders
stanza: Beware the bottled thoughts of angry young men
Secret compartments hide all of the skeletons
Little girl wants to make her home with him
In the middle of the shore, she wonders
